answer: Beacon heartbeat bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a cipher-sealed key at a knoll. Each epoch a beacon summons 1 in 10 identities; each must echo the cipher nonce in 10 minutes, proving liveness to a raven auditor. A missed or copied echo burns 20 credits, a second miss burns the bond; a shared key burns all sharers. Fakes pay 85, so 1000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 15,000; an honest agent pays once. Failure: rented-heartbeat ring.
